title: EvidenceBundle — append-only collection of signed predicate rows (Blueprint B § 2.4)
description: State machine: building → signing → signed → archived_to_rekor. APPEND-ONLY. Corrections = new bundle with new UUIDv7 referencing prior content_hash.

predicate_uri_set.description: Predicate URIs represented in this bundle's rows.

subject_set.description: Deduplicated in-toto Subject entries across all rows.

signing_mode.description: Signing posture. sigstore_staging is DR-010 Q3 default for predicates without normative SPEC.md (everything except gate-result/v1 at v1).

pre_registration_hash.description: Pre-registration commitment hash (D2 binding, v0.2.0 additive). `sha256:<hex>` digest of the pre-registration commitment artifact when the run was pre-registered, or null when it was not. ADDITIVE + OPTIONAL — every v0.1.0 bundle stays valid (absent ≡ null). Cross-field invariants governing when this MUST be non-null land in iec-E12; this is the field surface only.
